| 2026-10-19 | **Generic Practice Class: topic packs and a reviewed materials pipeline.** **What:** a topic pack is engine rules (error functions, item generator, tests) + a move list + a rubric + scenario values and personas + a materials kit; the Practice Class engine stays topic-agnostic, and a new topic or grade is a new pack. **Meshy pipeline (authoring time only):** (1) a scenario lists the materials it needs; (2) Claude Code calls the Meshy MCP server (`@meshy-ai/meshy-mcp-server`; text-to-3D, then remesh and retexture if needed); (3) a render step turns each model into 2D sprites with states (for example a bundle, then opened into 10 sticks), WebP of at most 15 KB or SVG; (4) sprites land in `content/materials/` with a manifest: id, names per language, interactions, and which simulator move each triggers; (5) gate 3 expert review before publish. **Constraints to carry forward:** error functions stay code, with tests and expert review (rule 1), and Claude may draft them but never owns them; a material counts only if it triggers a move in the simulator, and decoration is out; no photos of real children as inputs, and no personas with caste, religion or disability markers; record the Meshy plan type at generation time (as we understand it, paid plan: owned outputs; free plan: CC BY 4.0, which needs a credit line; verify on Meshy's terms page at generation time); the API key lives in the local environment only and is never committed; Meshy credits are separate from the USD 500 AI budget, which is never spent on assets. **Revisit when:** after the Build Stage result, or if the pilot verdict is positive. **First step:** pick one pilot topic and grade (candidates: fractions in Grade 4, time in Grade 3) and write its pack spec before generating anything at scale. | **Why parked:** off the critical path for the 1 Nov deadline (P05 to P12 are full); no live 3D (JS and data budgets, 2 GB RAM phones); no runtime generation (cost, latency, safety). Gopi asked for it, and per Gopi (unverified) about 1,000 Meshy credits expire in about a week | Gopi decides; Shivani and Seema review materials |

### Update 2026-10-22 · Sprites are SVG built here; Meshy stays for video and deck assets only
The tray materials, item pictures, mats and avatars for the Practice Class are now SVG drawn by our own renderer from JSON (`docs/design/sprite-system.md`, P17); nothing in the product needs a Meshy model. Meshy stays parked for what it is good at: video and deck assets (for example the roadmap slide). The topic-pack idea above is partly built: a pack of items, mats and templates is data and a second pack was added with no renderer change; the engine rules, move list and rubric of a new topic remain parked.
